---
title: "Figures that follow the toggle"
---

A cell can emit a light output and a dark output. Put the light output first:

```python
#| renderings: [light, dark]
```

With `askr-html` and `theme-toggle`, the dark stylesheet carries
`data-mode="dark"`, and the toggle adds `quarto-dark` to `body`. The
[Figures](../components/figures.qmd) page renders a pair of swatches this way.

## Wide figures and diagrams

Wrap a figure or Mermaid block in `.askr-wide-figure` to keep its natural label
size and scroll it inside a labelled, keyboard-focusable region. The drawing's
own intrinsic width sets the scroll extent; no fixed consumer width is needed.
Mermaid colors follow Askr's light and dark palettes.

````markdown
::: {.askr-wide-figure aria-label="Circuit signal path"}
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  Input --> Resonator --> Output
```
:::
````

This utility keeps native Quarto figures, captions and cross references.
